turns.q: Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
turns.replyTail:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out to MESHKI.

Before I can provide an order confirmation or discuss orders in detail, for security & privacy purposes, we do ask that you provide the following details;

Order Name
Order Email Address
Order Number
Item/s on the order

We appreciate your cooperation and understanding, as this step is crucial in information security and privacy protection.

Let me know if you have any questions. I am happy to help.

Kind regards,

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail: Maya, I understand you’d like to cancel your order and confirm the cancellation window. Your request has been escalated to our Manager, and our team will aim to get back to you within 24-48 hours. We’ll be in touch as soon as possible.
